name: secure-commerce
description: MIRA Commerce modular monolith với Next.js, NestJS, PostgreSQL và JWE/JWS application-layer protection.

scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && node scripts/with-env.mjs run dev:raw
scripts.build: npm run build -w @secure-commerce/crypto-envelope && npm run build -w @secure-commerce/domain && npm run build -w @secure-commerce/contracts && npm run db:generate && npm run build -w @secure-commerce/api && npm run build -w @secure-commerce/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run db:generate && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run test:upgrade:unit && npm run test:upgrade:services && npm run test:core && npm run test:security && npm run test:workspaces
scripts.test:core: npm run build -w @secure-commerce/crypto-envelope && npm run build -w @secure-commerce/domain && node --test scripts/acceptance-core.test.mjs
scripts.test:security: npm run build -w @secure-commerce/crypto-envelope && npm run build -w @secure-commerce/domain && npm run build -w @secure-commerce/contracts && npm run db:generate && npm run build -w @secure-commerce/api && node --test scripts/acceptance-security.test.mjs
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm test && npm audit --audit-level=high && docker compose config --quiet
scripts.dev:raw: concurrently -k -n API,WEB -c auto "npm run dev -w @secure-commerce/api" "npm run dev -w @secure-commerce/web"
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @secure-commerce/crypto-envelope && npm run build -w @secure-commerce/domain && npm run build -w @secure-commerce/contracts
